thesis: This pick carries the market's own probability and no edge, by construction. It is published as a calibration reference -- how good the market's own number is -- never as a reason to bet.

Its p_model is the board's own de-vigged consensus for this exact selection, republished unchanged by analyze()'s PROJECT phase under the identity map -- zero fitted parameters, no recalibration intercept, no Platt, no isotonic refit (docs/PREREG_CALIBRATED_PROBABILITY.md §2). Because the probability IS the price, diffing the two would measure nothing: edge_bps is structurally None and no edge is claimed. It is published as a calibration reference -- how good the market's own number is -- never as a reason to bet.

Its p_model is the board's own de-vigged consensus for this exact selection, republished unchanged by analyze()'s PROJECT phase under the identity map -- zero fitted parameters, no recalibration intercept, no Platt, no isotonic refit (docs/PREREG_CALIBRATED_PROBABILITY.md §2). Because the probability IS the price, diffing the two would measure nothing: edge_bps is structurally None and no edge is claimed. It is published as a calibration reference -- how good the market's own number is -- never as a reason to bet.

mechanism_predicates.claim: the ground-ball starter this side is backed behind actually pitched to the ground, at or above the league share of unambiguous batted-ball outs
mechanism_predicates.subject: backed_starter_batted_balls

thesis: Backing the away side of the moneyline because 1 pre-registered signal fired: (1) the opposing starter's career ground-ball share (starter_groundball_share; each side's number describes the matchup that side's own lineup faces): away 41.8%, home 58.3% (this game's own values rest on: away over 773 batted balls; home over 1,963 batted balls); a gap of 16.5 percentage points, clearing the threshold of 11.6 percentage points (rung 2 of 3, the 75th percentile of that gap over the ladder's derivation sample, 3,516 games with both sides measured, 2023-24). This mechanism's direction was frozen before any search ran at -1 (the side holding more of it is the side the mechanism harms), so the signal points to the away side. Pre-registered reason it should matter: a career ground-ball starter takes the air out of an offence that lives on balls in the air, so the lineup facing the higher ground-ball share is the disadvantaged side and club-level pricing averages the collision out. This is a signal count, not a forecast: it publishes no probability of its own, says nothing about whether the market's price is mistaken, and attaches no claim of value -- none has been earned. (Strategy: evolab genome 44faa9639a3a54e8.)

thesis: Backing the away side of the moneyline because 1 pre-registered signal fired: (1) this lineup's measured production against the primary pitch of the starter it faces (lineup_vs_primary_pitch; each side's number describes the matchup that side's own lineup faces): away 0.365 wOBA, home 0.315 wOBA (this game's own values rest on: away over 5,119 plate appearances; home over 347 plate appearances); a gap of 0.051 wOBA, clearing the threshold of 0.029 wOBA (rung 1 of 3, the 50th percentile of that gap over the ladder's derivation sample, 4,048 games with both sides measured, 2023-24). This mechanism's direction was frozen before any search ran at +1 (the side holding more of it is the side the mechanism favours), so the signal points to the away side. Pre-registered reason it should matter: a starter who leans on one pitch, against a lineup that has measurably hit that pitch, has nowhere to hide for eighteen outs; the market prices his season line, not tonight's specific collision. This is a signal count, not a forecast: it publishes no probability of its own, says nothing about whether the market's price is mistaken, and attaches no claim of value -- none has been earned. mechanism_predicates.claim: the lineup that has measurably hit this starter's primary pitch reaches base against him at or above the league rate starters allow -- 'nowhere to hide for eighteen outs', measured over the outs he actually got
mechanism_predicates.subject: backed_lineup_vs_opposing_starter

thesis: Backing the away side of the moneyline because 1 pre-registered signal fired: (1) this lineup's measured production against the primary pitch of the starter it faces (lineup_vs_primary_pitch; each side's number describes the matchup that side's own lineup faces): away 0.365 wOBA, home 0.315 wOBA (this game's own values rest on: away over 5,119 plate appearances; home over 347 plate appearances); a gap of 0.051 wOBA, clearing the threshold of 0.029 wOBA (rung 1 of 3, the 50th percentile of that gap over the ladder's derivation sample, 4,048 games with both sides measured, 2023-24). This mechanism's direction was frozen before any search ran at +1 (the side holding more of it is the side the mechanism favours), so the signal points to the away side. Pre-registered reason it should matter: a starter who leans on one pitch, against a lineup that has measurably hit that pitch, has nowhere to hide for eighteen outs; the market prices his season line, not tonight's specific collision. This is a signal count, not a forecast: it publishes no probability of its own, says nothing about whether the market's price is mistaken, and attaches no claim of value -- none has been earned. (Strategy: evolab genome 5f6d68dec562b5b3.)

thesis: This is a DELIBERATE CONTROL, not a pick anyone should follow: it takes the home side of the run line in every game, always, on no information at all. The direction was fixed in code before any board was read and is never derived from price, a clock or a search. Its p_model is a declared coin flip (provenance=placeholder), so no edge_bps can ever be computed for it -- that is the point: it is the baseline every real system has to beat (src.engine.adapters.evolab_system).

counterarguments.detail: books_at_decision=0 < 2
DEGRADED_INFORMATION: away_lineup: not present in assumption_exposure; home_lineup: not present in assumption_exposure; home_plate_umpire: not present in assumption_exposure

thesis: This pick carries the market's own probability and no edge, by construction. Its p_model is the board's own de-vigged consensus for this exact selection, republished unchanged by analyze()'s PROJECT phase under the identity map -- zero fitted parameters, no recalibration intercept, no Platt, no isotonic refit (docs/PREREG_CALIBRATED_PROBABILITY.md §2). Because the probability IS the price, diffing the two would measure nothing: edge_bps is structurally None and no edge is claimed. It is published as a calibration reference -- how good the market's own number is -- never as a reason to bet.
